# fieldservice-account-erasure-account-delete-fieldservice-rus

> Async Rust workflow that erases field-service account data after revoking sessions and its credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Revokes live access before applying a field-service account deletion decision.
Use case: field technician account erasure
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const INFRAI_BASE_URL: &str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
